jobs.occupation: Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry
jobs.description:
Our client is a global veterinary health company specialized in the research, development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products and vaccines for companion animals and livestock market. With a presence in 50 countries, our client is recognized as one of the top animal health companies worldwide. 

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following responsibilities:

Veterinary Service Manager: 

• Serve as the technical expert for animal health products (pharma & vaccines) for poultry 
• Provide scientific and technical support to veterinarians, farmers, and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Conduct training sessions, seminars, round tables and product demonstrations for veterinarians, farmers and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Develop your network of Key Opinion Leader (KOLs) within the poultry sector in the Benelux region. 
• Support the launch of new products by highlighting the technical & scientific benefits of the new products. 

Internal Collaboration:

• Work closely with the Sales teams to enhance customer engagement for Poultry products.
• Collaborate with the marketing team in the BENEDACH by providing technical & scientific advice on the creation of marketing support.

Market analysis & awareness: 

• Organize and participate to events and congresses to develop your network within the animal health industry and the expand the pharma, medicines and vaccines visibility within the Poultry sector.
• Represent the company at conferences, trade shows, and professional events.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging health challenges.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following profile:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree, Master Degree in Agriculture or equivalent.
• Experience / Knowledge in Poultry is mandatory. 
• You are autonomous with the willingness to travel in the Benelux region. 
• Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical guidance.
• Fluent in Dutch & English with a intermediate knowledge of French.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Polish - German - English
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.

JOB OVERVIEW

The SharePoint / Microsoft 365 Specialist will administer, improve and progressively develop KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.

You will work on our SharePoint intranet, Hub architecture, departmental Team Sites, document management, permissions and automation, while also supporting colleagues with existing SharePoint solutions.

The role combines hands-on technical work with business-process understanding. You will work closely with the allocated KOMIS Manager, Project Managers and users to translate operational needs into practical and maintainable Microsoft 365 solutions.

For someone who enjoys both technology and problem solving, this role offers considerable scope to shape solutions and see the direct impact of their work across the organisation.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SharePoint & Microsoft 365

• Administer, maintain and improve KOMIS's SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Support Project Managers and users with existing SharePoint sites and functionality.
• Configure and progressively develop the SharePoint Online intranet and Hub architecture.
• Create and maintain departmental SharePoint Team Sites connected to Microsoft Teams.
• Configure Hub navigation, Quick Links, News templates and aggregated news.
• Troubleshoot SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues and implement practical solutions.
Information, documents & access

• Configure document libraries, metadata, views and information structures.
• Support restructuring and migration of content from existing SharePoint sites.
• Manage Microsoft Entra ID security groups, permissions and access controls, including library-level permissions.
• Help maintain clear, secure and manageable access structures across SharePoint.
Automation & business solutions

• Develop SharePoint Lists and, progressively, Power Automate workflows and Power Apps where useful.
• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring business processes using Microsoft 365 tools.
Business support, testing & documentation

• Work with managers and users to understand business needs and translate them into practical Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Test new configurations and solutions before deployment.
• Document configurations, procedures and solutions and prepare user guidance where needed. 
QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

We are looking for someone who combines solid Microsoft 365 knowledge with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

You should have:

• At least 3 years of practical professional experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
• Solid knowledge of SharePoint sites, document libraries, permissions, metadata, views and Hub Sites.
• Experience integrating SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, security groups and access management.
• Practical experience with SharePoint Lists and Power Automate.
• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into Microsoft 365 solutions.
• Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills.
• Good written and spoken English.
NICE TO HAVE

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage: Microsoft Power Apps; Microsoft Graph; PowerShell or PnP PowerShell; SharePoint governance; SharePoint migration tools; Microsoft 365 security and compliance; Broader Microsoft Power Platform solutions.

You do not need to bring all of these from day one. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong SharePoint/Microsoft 365 foundation, sound judgement and willingness to develop further.
 
WHY JOIN US

This role offers the opportunity to have a visible impact on how KOMIS collaborates, manages information and uses technology across the organisation.

We offer:

• A role with real ownership and scope to shape solutions.
• The opportunity to develop a modern SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 environment.
• Exposure to different teams, business processes and international projects.
• A collaborative environment where initiative and practical ideas are encouraged.
• Brussels-based hybrid working arrangement.
At KOMIS, we value practical solutions, continuous improvement and people who take ownership of their work.
